settings.title: From pickup to
settings.intro: We don't just move boxes. We move information alongside them — so you always know where your freight is and when it will arrive.

features.title: Live shipment tracking
features.text: Every load reports its position in real time, so you can see exactly where your freight is without calling anyone.

features.title: Proactive delay alerts
features.text: When weather, traffic, or a breakdown threatens your ETA, we tell you before it becomes a problem — not after.

features.title: Multi-modal routing
features.text: We combine road, rail, and ocean to find the route that balances speed, cost, and reliability for each shipment.

features.title: One clear bill
features.text: No surprise surcharges, no line-item mysteries. You get a single, itemized invoice you can reconcile in minutes.

features.title: Dedicated coordinator
features.text: A named freight coordinator owns your account end to end — one person to call, who knows your freight and your deadlines.

features.title: Proof of delivery
features.text: Digital PODs and photos attach to every shipment automatically, so your records and your customers' are always in sync.

settings.title: One partner,
settings.intro: Whatever you're shipping and wherever it's going, Freightline has a lane for it. Pick the service, we handle the rest.

design.title: Full truckload (FTL)
design.text: Dedicated trailers for large or time-sensitive loads, with live tracking and a committed pickup window.

design.title: Temperature-controlled
design.text: Reefer trailers with monitored temperature and humidity for food, pharma, and other sensitive freight.

build.title: Less-than-truckload (LTL)
build.text: Cost-effective shared-trailer shipping for smaller pallets, with the same visibility as a full load.

build.title: Parcel & small package
build.text: Reliable small-parcel delivery with tracking numbers and delivery confirmation on every box.

launch.title: Rail & intermodal
launch.text: Long-haul rail combined with truck for the best balance of cost and transit time on cross-country freight.

launch.title: Ocean & port services
launch.text: Container shipping, customs coordination, and drayage to move your freight across borders without friction.

settings.title: From quote to

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: Tell us what you're shipping and where it's going. You get a clear, itemized quote within the hour — no hidden fees.

steps.title: Book
steps.text: Confirm the lane and we assign a carrier and a dedicated coordinator. Your pickup window is locked in.

steps.title: Move
steps.text: Your freight is picked up and tracked live. You get proactive alerts and a real-time ETA at every leg of the journey.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.text: Proof of delivery and photos attach to your shipment automatically. One clear bill follows, ready to reconcile.

settings.note: Most shippers see their freight-related delays drop by a third within the first quarter — because they stop chasing shipments and start watching them.

settings.title: Straight answers,
settings.intro: The questions shippers ask us most before they book their first load.

items.question: How fast can I get a quote?
items.answer: Most quotes come back within the hour. Tell us your origin, destination, freight type, and weight, and we'll send a clear, itemized quote with no hidden surcharges.

items.question: Do you handle temperature-controlled freight?
items.answer: Yes. We run a fleet of reefer trailers with monitored temperature and humidity for food, pharma, and other sensitive loads, and we flag any deviation immediately.

items.question: How do I track my shipment?
items.answer: Every load reports live GPS position and a real-time ETA. You get a tracking link and proactive alerts at every leg — no phone calls required.

items.question: What if my shipment is delayed?
items.answer: We tell you before it becomes a problem. If weather, traffic, or a breakdown threatens your ETA, we alert you and work the network to find a faster route or a backup carrier.

items.question: How are you different from a freight broker?
items.answer: A broker hands you off to whoever's cheapest. Freightline gives you a dedicated coordinator, live visibility, and one accountable partner from pickup to delivery — with a single clear bill at the end.

settings.title: Let's move your freight
settings.intro: Tell us what you're shipping and where it's going. We'll send a clear quote within the hour — no sales gauntlet, no hidden fees.
